title: Extra Treat (1036)
problem: Dumpling cast limit is set to 3, but the cast counter is raised before the limit compare, so at most limit − 1 = 2 casts fit (the same off-by-one gives 14 / 15 normal casts).
notes: Community claim: "Maximum of 3 casts per turn" actually allows 2. Evidence: bc_CreatureCast limit = 3 @0x1406fe182 / 0x140755c6e; clamp casts - 1 >= 3 @0x140755c61. Fix sketch: Raise the Extra Treat constant 3 → 4 (K), or fix the off-by-one for all casts (S) Triage 2026-10-26: K: Extra Treat cast limit 3 -> 4 (@0x1406fe182 / 0x140755c6e), so 3 casts fit under the counter's off-by-one. 2026-10-26: built as byte patch SU-0150 (verified against the baseline exe; not yet run in game).

release_notes.intended: Your Dumplings' spells cost no charges, but they can cast a maximum of 3 times per turn.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, only 2 casts per turn fit.
release_notes.fix: Now 3 casts per turn are allowed.
